$comment: Machine-readable twin of tests/KNOWN_FAILURES.md, read by scripts/ci-known-failures.ts in the CI gate (.github/workflows/e2e.yml). KNOWN_FAILURES.md stays the human explanation; keep both in step. Match = browser + file (relative to tests/e2e) + full title (describe titles joined with ' › '); line numbers are informational only. kind: 'failure' = fails every full run; 'flaky' = load-dependent, fails some runs. ciOnly: true = seen only in GitHub Actions, not locally.
